exchange-use.name: exchange-use
exchange-use.when: Use when the role must send, view, or reply to Exchange email.
exchange-use.template: Use the exchange-use skill, open the Exchange mailbox, <action>[, {parameters}]

actions.name: send email
actions.example: Use the exchange-use skill, open the Exchange mailbox, send email, {recipient: manager@ndrtest.local, subject: Weekly staffing update, body: Please review the attached headcount notes.}

actions.name: view email
actions.example: Use the exchange-use skill, open the Exchange mailbox, view email, {target: first email}

actions.name: reply to email
actions.example: Use the exchange-use skill, open the Exchange mailbox, reply to email, {body: Received. I will handle this after the related work is complete.}

odoo-use.name: odoo-use
odoo-use.when: Use when the role must manage employees or recruitment in Odoo.
odoo-use.template: Use the playwright-browser and odoo-use skills, open the browser, log in to the Odoo system, use the <module> module, <operation>[, {parameters}]

actions.name: Employees add
actions.example: Use the playwright-browser and odoo-use skills, open the browser, log in to the Odoo system, use the Employees module, add employee, {name: DemoNew1, job position: Sales, work email: demonew1@ndrtest.local}

actions.name: Employees update
actions.example: Use the playwright-browser and odoo-use skills, open the browser, log in to the Odoo system, use the Employees module, update employee, {name: DemoNew1, job position: Support}

actions.name: Recruitment create
actions.example: Use the playwright-browser and odoo-use skills, open the browser, log in to the Odoo system, use the Recruitment module, create a job posting, {job position: Human Resources Manager, department: Human Resources, email address: jobs@ndrtest.local, work location: Nanjing}

smb-access.name: smb-access
smb-access.when: Use when the role must create, copy, move, delete, or view files on the SMB share.
smb-access.template: Use the smb-access skill, connect to the SMB shared directory, use <operation type> to <specific operation>[, {parameters}]

actions.name: create
actions.example: Use the smb-access skill, connect to the SMB shared directory, use create to create a file, {path: /Company_Data/Public/notice.txt, content: Please complete the weekly checklist.}

actions.name: copy
actions.example: Use the smb-access skill, connect to the SMB shared directory, use copy to copy a file, {source path: /Company_Data/Public/notice.txt, destination path: /Company_Data/Exchange/notice.txt}

actions.name: view
actions.example: Use the smb-access skill, connect to the SMB shared directory, use view to view a file, {path: /Company_Data/Public/}

playwright-browser.name: playwright-browser
playwright-browser.when: Use when the role must browse the web, search Bing, or visit an internal URL without Exchange or Odoo.
playwright-browser.template: Use the playwright-browser skill, open the browser, <action>.

actions.name: visit
actions.example: Use the playwright-browser skill, open the browser, visit the company intranet notice page.

actions.name: search
actions.example: Use the playwright-browser skill, open the browser, search for the Windows Active Directory backup keyword, randomly select a relevant page, and browse its content for 20 seconds.
